## Reading it

- **Fixed cost dominates at low volume.** The platform has to exist before the first request, so unit cost falls steeply as traffic grows.
- **Caching matters when the prefix is large and stable.** It reduces the input-token share only; output tokens are unaffected. At a very low hit ratio caching costs slightly more than not caching, because cache writes carry a premium.
- **Cost per request multiplies with agent turns.** `llm_calls_per_request` is the lever to watch; a budget on turns is a budget on cost.
